gaps.sentence: The results ___ (publish) on the university website next Friday.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle. 'Next Friday' fixes the future reference.

gaps.sentence: This form ___ (sign) in ink — digital signatures aren't valid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + past participle. Obligation: must (also has to) be signed.

gaps.sentence: While the sets ___ (build), the actors rehearsed in a warehouse.
gaps.hint: two past actions, one passive and ongoing
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive (were being built) for the longer background action.

gaps.sentence: The markings ___ (see) with the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: cannot be + seen. The context (astronomy) implies impossibility.
Past simple passive: was + demolished. The demolition company is not mentioned.

gaps.sentence: She ___ (think) to be the finest violinist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal passive: is thought to be. The thinkers are general, not stated.

gaps.sentence: The temple is thought ___ (build) more than two thousand years ago.
gaps.explanation: Perfect passive infinitive: to have been + built for an event earlier than the main verb.
Negative present simple passive: are not + past participle (given).
